lina: Noticed a drift on quant-m15k-int4 after ~11k tokens. output repeats a prior clause and semantics shift. suspect RoPE scaling with KV merge.
op: Is this streaming? any repro?
lina: streaming=on, kv_cache on. quick repro below. switched posscale smoothing off and drift disappears.
chew: can you dump kv index checksums before/after flush? also which kernel (fused vs per-layer)?
lina: dump: before 10998: a1b2c3d4..., after 11003: f9e8d7c6...; kernel: fused-int4 v2.
op: runtime log shows pos_scale adjust at layer 18 near seq 11000 and kv:merge at 11001.
chew: That timing smells like mismatch. two fixes: rebase posscale before merge OR apply scale during merge. rebase favored.
infra-bot: Canary requested on pool-aurora, job id 9903.
lina: adding golden case to tests/longctx/goldens/posscale-kv-shift.txt and creating regression.
op: thanks — keep short logs here and link s3 when available. :thumbsup:
